data.name: Evalyn
data.gender_notes: Evalyn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Aevalone, meaning strong, healthful, gentle. In legend, Aevalone was a nymph who protected gardens and fields. In Christianity, the name Evelyn or Evalyn is derived from the Hebrew name Hevel, meaning breath or soul. The name Evalyn carries the meaning “Strong, healthful, gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evalyn usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, healthful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of new beginnings and growth.
data.etymology: Evalyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, healthful, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evalyn total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Evalyn was popularized in Western culture during the Middle Ages. It gained significant popularity during the Victorian Era, when poetic and romantic names were in vogue. Evalyn also has associations with the Celtic and Anglican traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Evalyn represents the soul and breath of life. In Christianity, it is a reminder of the spiritual essence within each person, as well as the vital role of the breath in our physical lives. It is a name that evokes a sense of strength, health, and gentleness - qualities that are highly valued in the spiritual journey. Additionally, the association withEvalyn as a protector of gardens and fields reflects the Christian belief in the importance of stewardship and reverence for the natural world.
